# FMC Media PC 0.3.2

- Fixes "Title unavailable — HTTP 429 Too Many Requests" on anime pages: the app now paces its AniList requests (about 30 a minute, shared by every page) and waits out AniList's rate limit instead of failing.
- When AniList is busy, the title page says so and tries again by itself.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
